description: The bar chart, titled "The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets," illustrates the number of datasets published each year from 2012 to 2022, categorized by the number of targets involved in the hate communication. The horizontal axis represents the year, while the vertical axis indicates the "Number of datasets," scaled from 0 to 100 in increments of 20. Two data series are shown: blue bars represent datasets with one target ("1"), and orange bars represent datasets with two or more targets ("2+"). The data reveals a significant increase in the number of published datasets over the decade. In 2012, only one dataset with a single target was published, while no datasets with two or more targets were published. The number of datasets with a single target remained low until 2016, when it began a steady increase, peaking in 2020 with 87 datasets. The number of datasets with two or more targets also grew, starting in 2017, and reached its peak in 2020 with 44 datasets. The most significant increase in total dataset publications occurred between 2019 and 2020. In 2022, the number of datasets with a single target dropped to 30, while the number of datasets with two or more targets decreased to 7.
